name: grip
description: Figma plugin + local bridge exposing full canvas read/write to MCP agents

scripts.//: Nothing generated is committed. `npm run build` is the LOCAL build: it writes bridge/grip-bridge.mjs, bridge/install.mjs, bridge/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt and figma-plugin/code.js (all gitignored). CI runs the same build to make the release assets. `npm test` builds first, so a clean checkout + `npm run setup` + `npm test` is enough.
scripts.setup: npm --prefix src/bridge ci && npm --prefix src/plugin ci
scripts.build: npm --prefix src/bridge run build && npm --prefix src/plugin run build && npm run build:notices
scripts.test: npm run build && npm --prefix src/bridge test && npm --prefix src/bridge run test:win && node --test scripts/release-gate.test.mjs scripts/package-release.test.mjs scripts/sign-release.test.mjs scripts/bundle-hygiene.test.mjs scripts/third-party-notices.test.mjs scripts/audit-gate.test.mjs
